insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for unfulfilled orders. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new destination. The update is applicable as of September 9, 2026.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should be aware of this change when updating orders through the GraphQL Admin API, especially if their apps handle shipping address changes. They should test their apps to ensure compatibility with the new tax recalculation behavior. The orderUpdate mutation will now return updated tax information, which may affect downstream processes. Additionally, developers should review their apps' tax handling logic to ensure it aligns with this change.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations when shipping addresses are updated, which can impact their order totals and customer experience. This change ensures compliance with tax regulations and reduces potential errors.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and ensures compliance with tax regulations, which is crucial for merchants and developers alike. It also enhances the overall customer experience by providing accurate order totals.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefront functionality, Hydrogen deployment, and order management

themes.title: Storefront Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP support is added for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with stores. This update also includes serving UI extension source maps during app development.

themes.title: Hydrogen and Deployment
themes.detail: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing deployment of Hydrogen storefronts without a paid plan. However, development stores do not include public environments, affecting deployment URLs.

themes.title: Order Management
themes.detail: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, enhancing order import and management capabilities.
